title: Log entry
description: One entry in any of the four logs.

phase.description: The phase it belongs to; nexus fills it in.

text.description: The entry itself, in one sentence.

status.description: Allowed values depend on the log (table below).

source.description: Where it came from: "chat 11:20", "scope gate", a test.

commit.description: Optional commit hash, mainly for the change log.

raisedBy.description: Who raised it: the user, the agent running the build, or a helper agent (a subagent, advisor or workflow). Required for guardrails.

task.description: The plan task this entry came from, set by `nexus ledger import`.

topic.description: The concept topic a live-mode refinement belongs to; Concepts › Chosen lists it.
